slides.say: HTML lets you leave some tags open. JSX does not.
An image tag needs a slash at the end, to self close. A list item needs its closing tag.

slides.text: Self-closing tags end with /> . Wrapping tags need </tag>.
slides.say: So: tags with nothing inside end with slash and angle bracket. Tags that wrap content need a closing tag.
Takeaway: when you paste HTML into JSX, close every tag explicitly.
